evidence.description: Report 24-004934: patrol unit responded to a reported burglary at a commercial premises in Central District, Seattle, WA; premises type commercial; date Tuesday, April 9, 2024; time approximately 03:30.
Business security footage shows a large group outside, repeated attempts to break the doors, entry into the store, and the group fleeing in two cars.
A stolen Hyundai Sonata was rammed into the front doors, wedged between the doors and bike stands near the sidewalk.
Officer noted camera coverage at the premises.
Group of more than 10 people, described as a mix of young adults and children, per the narrative. No individual identified or recorded.
Products worth thousands of dollars and cash taken.
